title: The Wrong Item
brief: A pharmacy chain customer of Meridian Logistics reports that order {{ord}} contained 40 units of a similar-looking product instead of the one ordered. They ask for a response within 24 hours. You have 12 visit points to contain, find the cause, and respond.

actions.label: Other orders with the same item that day
General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: Complaint CS-881 for {{ord}} logged within 1 hour with photos.
7 other orders picked from the same location that day went to 5 customers; none checked.
evidence.missedExplanation: Check other orders from the same location.

evidence.text: Look-alike products sit in adjacent locations C-14 and C-15 with similar packaging.
evidence.whyItMatters: Process conditions should prevent predictable mix-ups.
evidence.missedExplanation: Look at what sits next to what.

evidence.text: Pick confirmation for {{ord}} used location scan only, not product barcode (method M-2).
Slotting change SL-40, 2 weeks ago, placed the look-alikes side by side; no review against the look-alike list.
evidence.whyItMatters: Changes must be reviewed for effect.

evidence.text: Outbound check counts cartons but does not verify item codes (check OC-1).
evidence.whyItMatters: Verifying codes at outbound would catch errors.

evidence.text: Look-alike product list LA-1 exists and is current.
evidence.whyItMatters: Risk identified; not used in slotting.

evidence.text: Picker: "The system only asks for the location scan." Accurate.
Lighting is adequate, measured at the standard level.
Picker headset is a newer model.

options: Collection and replacement for {{ord}}, checks of the 7 other orders, the immediate cause (look-alikes side by side, location-only scanning), actions with dates, and a contact
A statement that the picker has been warned
A request that the customer sorts the goods
decisions.rationale: The customer needs containment, cause, and a plan, not blame.

containment: Contact the 5 other customers and check the 7 orders
cause: Slotting change ignored the look-alike list and pick confirmation scans location only
corrective: Separate look-alikes, require product barcode scan, and check slotting changes against LA-1
effectiveness: Track wrong-item complaints for six months

debriefText.found: You contained across orders and found the slotting and scan causes.
debriefText.missed: Look at what sits next to the wrong item.
debriefText.falseFinding: Lighting and headsets were not causes.
